videos.description:
Ambubachi mela 2022 kamekha temple🙏
   
Ambubachi Mela is an annual Hindu Mela held to worship Goddess Kamakhya. It is the most important festival of the Kamakhya temple and is celebrated every year in June. 'Ambubachi' means spoken with water and it also implies that the rains expected during this month make the earth fertile and ready for procreation.
